chunks: Aban, from 'Abd al-Rahman, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
"If the boy steals and has not yet experienced ihtilam, the tips of his fingers are cut." He said, and he said: "None carried this out except the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and I."

key_terms.أَنَا: I, referring to the speaker, Imam Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام
key_terms.الصَّبِيُّ: a boy, referring here to a minor who has not reached puberty
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ: the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family
key_terms.قُطِعَتْ: was cut, referring to the prescribed physical punishment
key_terms.يَحْتَلِمْ: to experience a wet dream, indicating legal puberty

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in Tahdhib al-Ahkam on a prepubescent boy who commits theft?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling concerning theft committed by a boy who has not yet reached puberty through ihtilam. It also states that this specific punishment was only carried out by the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the Imam عليه السلام, indicating its exceptional judicial authority.
